notes.title: [Rise of Kenshin] is officially online!
notes.notes:
[Rise of Kenshin] is officially online! 🎉

Dear players, after a long time of hard work, our indie game “Rise of Kenshin ” is finally coming to you! Thank you for your support and anticipation along the way! 💖

🌍 [b]Game Features[/b]:

[b]8 brand new maps[/b]: each map is full of challenges and surprises!
[b]Epic Difficulty[/b]: The game's difficulty has been opened to epic, allowing you to experience unprecedented challenges!
[b]Sword Immortal Breakthrough[/b]: All 8 characters can break through to Sword Immortal, unlocking powerful talents and opening up a whole new way of fighting!
[b]Weapon System[/b]: The new weapon system allows you to both fight and run, both offense and defense, more flexible combat!

Thank you for your experience feedback, it is your support that keeps us moving forward! 💪 The story of the game has just begun, there are more exciting updates and content waiting for you in the future! ✨

🎮 Join us and explore this brand new world together!
📱 Official QQ group: 215699722, more information and benefits waiting for you!

notes.title: Rise of Kenshin Playtest Opens 26th May
notes.notes:
The Playtest version will be available on 26 May 2024 at 10am BST.

        After the previous tests and feedback, the game balance and playability have been greatly improved. The playtest will be open on a larger scale and will last until the official version is released. It is not shared with the official version archive, as it is in a different directory, but it is compatible and can be overwritten manually. If there is a strong demand for it, we may do an auto-detect overwrite function later.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990586/894caf4d37050faa4d6e5bbf5b8e6a4c13ec18b8.jpg[/img]

This Playtest is an open beta.
        [list]
[*] No newbie guide is done, shouldn't be needed, I guess.
[*] The character's Sword Immortal realm evolution is open, but the process requires self-exploration and won't be as smooth as it could be (if you don't check the guide.).
[*] The Epic Mode after Sword Immortal, which is a bit more difficult, is reserved for subsequent features, and the subsequent new drops are not yet developed, so the payoffs are well, just plain cocky. If you feel that there is no challenge you can try, it is not impossible to fight, I believe you will have a deeper understanding of the skill system.
[*] Online is basically stable, still need more testing and feedback, welcome to troll.
[*] New features will continue to be updated in the beta.
[/list]

Welcome to join the official QQ group: 215699722

notes.title: Version 0.61beta update
notes.notes:
Updated content
Fixed bugs in skills with spike characteristics and added feedback sound effects.
Adjusted the trigger probability of spike skills.
Adjusted the balance of several skills.
Adjusted the number of points gained from character advancement 10/20/30. Increased initial movement speed by 10%.
Increased the difficulty of each challenge by one notch, and now you need to pay attention to the control characteristics of the skills in the highest difficulty, or else it will be difficult to pass the level.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: The first wave of beta testing is now open
notes.notes:
The game opened a small internal test, although it is not perfect, but we urgently need to hear the feedback from players, listen to hear the players' feelings and suggestions, in order to improve the game experience next. The content is still incomplete, but the main features can basically be experienced. If you are interested, you can get a beta code from the official QQ group. Or go to indienova.com to apply for a test code. We'll keep updating, and hope to receive a wave of wish lists and sincere suggestions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990586/7df85ea17194164e73e3609dbfc7d57b525bc86b.png[/img]
Warm tips: The day before the game went live in beta I felt the difficulty was on the easy side and temporarily adjusted the number of bonus points for character advancement. If you think it is too difficult or bad experience, (as shown) you can click reset, you can restore the original settings. Or you can leave some of your characters unreset to see which experience is better. Wish you a happy game.
 
Official Q Group: 215699722
Test code application address https://indienova.com/g/rise--3
